name: v0.22.0
body:
## Co-op Translator 0.22.0

This release makes **Microsoft Agent Framework the default translation backend**, adds Manipuri language support, improves translation reporting and link migration, and expands provider onboarding documentation.

### Highlights

- Microsoft Agent Framework is now the default backend.
- Added Manipuri (`mni`) language support.
- Added configurable Anthropic maximum token limits.
- Link migration no longer requires LLM provider credentials.
- Successful retranslations of outdated files are now counted correctly.
- Added real translation examples and improved provider onboarding documentation.

### Dependencies

- Updated `urllib3` from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0.
- Updated `PyJWT` from 2.13.0 to 2.15.0.

## What's Changed

- Docs: Add real translation examples and provider onboarding by @skytin1004 in #541
- Build(deps): Bump urllib3 from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 by @dependabot in #547
- Build(deps): Bump pyjwt from 2.13.0 to 2.15.0 by @dependabot in #546
- Core: Count successful outdated retranslations by @skytin1004 in #549
- Core: Add Manipuri support and configurable Anthropic token limits by @pterrajkumar in #545
- Core: Verify Agent Framework OpenAI parity by @skytin1004 in #544
- Core: Allow link migration without provider credentials by @skytin1004 in #550
- Core: Make Agent Framework the default by @skytin1004 in #551
- Build: Bump version to 0.22.0 by @skytin1004 in #552

## New Contributors

- Welcome @pterrajkumar, who made their first contribution in #545!

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.21.0...v0.22.0
